tasks.description:

**Files:** grammar/Wok.cf (after DInstance :108); regenerate src-generated/GeneratedParser/Wok/{Abs.hs,Par.y,Lex.x,Print.hs,Layout.hs}; parser test.

tasks.subject: Task 2: IO ground effect — registration + entry-point discharge

**Files:** src/Wok/TypeChecking/Builtins.hs (seed IO); Infer.hs (post-closeRow entry pass :~3288; reject IO handler); Error.hs (IOEffectNotHandleable); typecheck tests.

tasks.subject: Task 3: Foreign-module registration + lookupForeignModule + resolution + blessed honesty check
tasks.description:
**Goal:** DForeign registers Libc into envForeignModules; Libc.member resolves to its declared type (with IO); unblessed (lib,sym) is a clean error; unknown member / ambiguous head error clearly.

**Files:** CREATE src/Wok/FFI/Blessed.hs (allow-list memchr=Scalar, strndup=Adopt); Env.hs (ForeignModuleInfo/ForeignMember/envForeignModules/lookupForeignModule); Infer.hs (collect DForeign; EProj arm :1795); Error.hs (3 new errors); wok.cabal.

**Files:** Infer.hs (gate :3340-3346 / externDecls :3411-3418 — confirm DForeign not collected; guard only if needed); typecheck tests.

tasks.subject: Task 5: Foreign-call IR + elaboration + reference-interp execution
tasks.description:
**Goal:** A resolved foreign-member application elaborates to a ForeignCall node (lib, symbol, ReturnDisp, freeSym, args); the reference interpreter executes Libc.memchr/strndup via faithful pure Haskell models.

**Files:** Anf.hs (ForeignCall, args borrowed, distinct from APrim); Elaborate.hs (emit ForeignCall); Interp/Prim.hs + Interp/Value.hs (reference eval + memchr/strndup models); reference test.

**Verify:** cabal test --test-options='--match "/foreign reference/"' 2>&1 | tail -20

tasks.subject: Task 6: RC backends — real ccall + borrow-out + adopt + differential parity
tasks.description:

**Files:** RC/Heap.hs (ccall memchr/strndup/strlen; reuse Slice-1 foreign_bytes allocs); RC/Prim.hs + RC/Value.hs (RC ForeignCall eval; borrow-out; Adopt/Copy/Scalar disposition); test/Spec.hs oracle wiring.
